tea_party.title: もりの おちゃかい

opening.narration: もりの あきちで、プーが テーブルの ところに すわって いました。
opening.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits at a small wooden table in a forest clearing, with teacups, plates and a honey pot on the table and a blue balloon tied nearby, smiling as if welcoming a guest.

eeyore_birthday.title: イーヨーの おたんじょうび

opening.narration: 100エーカーの もりの あきちで、プーが テーブルの ところに すわって いました。
opening.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits at a small wooden table in a forest clearing, thinking with a paw on its chin. On the table are cups, plates and a full honey pot; colorful balloons and a ribbon lie nearby.

honey_gift_committed.narration: プーは、イーヨーへの おくりものを きめました。
honey_gift_committed.prompt: The seated bear gently holds an upright closed brown ceramic jar with both paws in its lap. The jar has a fitted lid and a small blue ribbon. The bear smiles quietly, pleased with the prepared gift. Its mouth and paws are clean.

pooh_tastes_honey.narration: プーは、ひとくちだけの つもりで、はちみつの つぼを もちだしました。
pooh_tastes_honey.prompt: The seated bear steadies an upright brown ceramic jar in its lap with one paw and lifts its lid with the other. Some amber honey is visible inside. It looks into the jar with a curious, gently tempted smile. Its mouth and paws are still clean.

pooh_ate_honey.narration: きが つくと、つぼの なかの はちみつは、すっかり なくなって いました。
pooh_ate_honey.prompt: This bear from the reference image sits with an empty honey pot tipped on its side in its lap, a little honey on its paw and mouth, looking surprised and a bit sorry.

story_wrap_up.narration: こうして、イーヨーへの おくりものが きまりました。
story_wrap_up.prompt: This bear from the reference image walks happily carrying a wrapped birthday present in one paw and waving goodbye with the other empty paw. No balloon or balloon string.

participant_presence: The person this bear is with (the reader) is never drawn as a whole figure: no face or body. When the scene has them handing, holding out or touching something, only their hand and forearm reach into the picture from its edge. Otherwise they are present only as a soft, faceless gray shadow falling into the scene from the bottom edge, as if the reader were standing just outside the picture.
